method: Seeded real-schema storage fixture (not an HTTP throughput measurement): 25% spans (10/trace), 25% logs (one quarter trace-correlated), 50% gauge points; ten services on two hosts, every fourth metric batch host-only. One-second event spacing, 30s/5s context padding. Full raw synthetic records, durable writer batches of 256 and shutdown finalization. Query clock includes query, row decoding, iteration and close, excludes EXPLAIN. Five repeats on one read-only connection; first is connection-cold, OS filesystem caches are not flushed. Required time windows and LIMIT 100. File size is after all writers close/checkpoint; free pages reported separately. Context view counts are logical links, scope counts are physical rows. Logical context view counts omitted in this query-only report, not reported as zero. Exact counts are measured separately.

queries.name: service_time
queries.sql: SELECT s.evidence_id,s.kind,s.ts_ns,s.data FROM signals s JOIN resources r ON r.resource_id=s.resource_id WHERE json_extract(r.attrs,'$."service.name"')=? AND s.ts_ns>=? AND s.ts_ns<? ORDER BY s.ts_ns,s.evidence_id LIMIT ?

queries.name: log_templates
queries.sql: SELECT json_extract(s.data,'$.template') AS template,count(*) FROM signals s JOIN resources r ON r.resource_id=s.resource_id WHERE s.kind='log' AND json_extract(r.attrs,'$."service.name"')=? AND s.ts_ns>=? AND s.ts_ns<? GROUP BY template ORDER BY count(*) DESC,template LIMIT ?
